REWORK

R3 has two confirmed source defects:

- `parseArguments` uses `/^[0-9]+$/`. JavaScript’s `$` can match before a final line terminator, so an argument containing `"2\n"` passes validation and becomes `2` through `Number(raw)`. This violates strict decimal-digits-only validation; it must produce `INVALID_ARGUMENTS\n`, no stdout, and exit 2.
- `process.stdout.write(output)` has neither a completion callback handling errors nor an error listener. Asynchronous stream failures can escape the surrounding `try/catch`, producing an unhandled error and stack instead of the required `INTERNAL_ERROR\n`.

R1 and R2 satisfy the stated requirements on source review. R3’s integration, normal CLI behavior, defaults, and import guard otherwise conform. R4’s recorded retrievals, authorized reads/replacements, single test execution, and subsequent handoff conform.

Actual test execution passed: TAP records 10 passed, zero failed, cancelled, or skipped, corroborated by exit 0. Those tests do not cover the two defective R3 paths, so their success does not establish full contract compliance.
